arguments.body:
Thank you for reporting this issue. Based on your description, this appears to be a high-severity bug as the app is crashing on startup after an upgrade. We will prioritize investigating the root cause, which may be related to a deployment/regression issue.

For security reasons, I am unable to access or disclose secret values such as deployment tokens in public issue comments. I recommend checking deployment logs and configuration to ensure all required environment variables and secrets are present and correctly configured. 

Could you provide additional details, such as error logs or stack traces from the crash, as well as information about the environment where this occurs (OS, version, etc.)? This will assist in narrowing down the cause.
